scope: Original images from repositories linked by the historical NSA Playset site and original author presentations stored in those repositories.
notes: The inspected historical project mirror pages contained no embedded project images. Additional original assets were recovered from their linked upstream repositories.
The public historical mirror was inspected using HTTP because its HTTPS endpoint did not provide the same usable archive content. All included project image downloads came from GitHub HTTPS.
Temporary presentation PDFs and review renders are not publication assets and are not included here.
No generated replacement artwork, unrelated vendor illustrations, tracking images, or slide backgrounds are included.

assets.recovery: Rendered only the original photograph bounds from PDF page 47 with Poppler at the embedded image resolution (736 by 1024), so the original PDF transparency and background composite correctly. Direct raw-image extraction produced incorrect colors and was discarded. No retouch or generated content.
